chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch.239 – Han Li's Choice: The Three-Type Cultivation Technique Hierarchy Explained
chapter_meta_description: Han Li finally claims his compensation from Li Huayuan, but the choice of technique is harder than he expected. A deep dive into the three-type cultivation system and what it means for his future.
og_description: Han Li picks his cultivation path after a masterclass lecture on the three types of techniques. The choice is everything.
twitter_description: Han Li finally gets his reward, but the path forward is a choice between power now or power later. A quiet, strategic chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: A type of False Spiritual Root with four elemental affinities; cultivators with such roots face severe cultivation bottlenecks but can technically train in most elemental techniques.
A rare physique second only to a Heavenly Spiritual Root, granting exceptional compatibility with Yang-aligned cultivation methods; Li Huayuan's own constitution.
A top-tier Yang-element cultivation technique that Li Huayuan successfully practices due to his Triple Yang Constitution; its power and danger are both extreme.
The cultivation stage above Foundation Establishment; forming a Golden Core is the dream of nearly every Foundation Establishment cultivator and the ultimate test of talent and resources.
